_comment: 'Twice per Turn Instant' was hand-rolled as a FLAG_SET condition with count:2/comparison:'lt' plus a SET_FLAG with increment:true -- and FLAG_SET reads neither count nor comparison, and SET_FLAG does not read increment. So the condition was just 'is this flag set', gated on the flag the ability's OWN effects set: the ability could only be used after it had already been used, i.e. never. `per_turn` is the real field, enforced by play.py through has_per_turn_limit/activations. The ability is also an INSTANT, not a plain ACTIVATE, so it can be used during combat -- which is the only time '+1{p} to this' means anything.
